title: prestonia marginata
intro: Prestonia marginata, commonly known as "Yellow Dog's Tooth", is a species of flowering plant in the Apocynaceae family native to tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Prestonia marginata include reducing fever, relieving pain, and acting as an expectorant to ease respiratory congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
